cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring that empty box to my desk. I'm checking that the team follows my directions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you ask instead of barking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Would you bring it, please? Choose whichever route is clear; I want this to work smoothly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. Can I get back to my job?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, after you take it back by the far corridor. At your own pace. I just need to see that a second request works as well as the first; then I'll know we're cooperating.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 barking objection causes A3 asking politely; B4 completion/job request causes A5 second test before return to real work.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants respectful treatment and B4 to resume useful work; A accommodates manner but not the pointless burden.

heightening.evidence: A5 success becomes grounds for a farther reverse trip, increasing inconvenience while calling it cooperation.
